group: Use case stylized-concept. Create a transparent pixel art animation atlas showing Finn, Jake and BMO from Adventure Time RESTING HUDDLED TOGETHER, using attached three sheets as exact character-design and pixel-style references. White hat and cyan shirt Finn with green backpack, golden yellow dog Jake with round muzzle, turquoise game-console BMO. Preserve chunky black pixel outlines and flat colorful chibi proportions; simple square pixels, no gradients. TRUE transparent background, no scenery, no glow, no text, no labels, no grid lines. Regular 4-column by 4-row atlas, output 1536x1024, exactly 16 cells of 384x256 each. Each cell contains one compact group of exactly these 3 characters together, no extras. All groups consistently scaled and positioned with baseline at cell 85% and ample margin. Left Finn seated leaning inward, center Jake curled into a soft dog cushion, right smaller BMO nestled next to them. Finn's golden sword rests flat safely to the far left, not poking anyone. ROW 1: FOUR FRAME LOOP ALL ASLEEP HUDDLED, Finn eyes closed leaning on curled Jake, BMO sleepy screen, subtle breathing and tiny eyelid changes; peaceful. ROW 2: FOUR FRAME WAKING transition, eyes opening, stretch, sit up, ready but still together. ROW 3: FOUR FRAME RETURN TO REST transition, standing near each other, sit close, lean against Jake, eyes close. ROW 4: FOUR FRAME TEAM COMPLETION, all smile together, Finn thumbs up and Jake arms up, BMO screen green check and tiny hop, all settle contentedly together. No floating symbols except tiny positive pixel sparkle on completion.
iceking: Use case stylized-concept. Create ICE KING from Adventure Time as a chunky low-resolution pixel art sprite atlas matching attached Finn sheet's scale and simple outlines. Blue skin, long pointed nose, large white beard, blue robe, gold three-point crown with red jewels, small black pixel eyes. Cute squat chibi interpretation, retain characteristic silhouette and crown. True transparent background, no glow, no scenery, no shadows, no labels, no lettering, no grid lines. EXACTLY SIX COLUMNS and SIX ROWS, 36 poses, square canvas 1536x1536, regular invisible 256x256 cells, one sprite per cell centered with consistent baseline and plenty of space, all effects stay within cell. ROW 1 six TURNAROUND poses: front, right, back, left, front-left three-quarter, back-right three-quarter. ROW 2 six-frame lonely friendly IDLE: look around, blink, beard sway, little shrug and return. No target or other character. ROW 4 six-frame hovering LEFT locomotion: robe lifts and beard billows with subtle up/down movement, maintain left-facing. ROW 5 six-frame PEACEFUL DRUMMING: seated at tiny simple blue drum with two sticks, tap left, tap right, happy flourish, relaxed beat; keep crown beard and face visible. ROW 6 six-frame RESOLVED ENCOUNTER: puzzled, hands lower, sheepish smile, apologetic wave, small snow puff, friendly relaxed pose. Comic and sympathetic, not frightening. Crisp stepped outlines, solid flat colors, no smooth gradients or painted texture.
